---
name: Bug report
about: Report an error, inaccuracy, or broken link in the brief
title: "[brief] "
labels: bug
---

## What's wrong

A clear, concise description of the error (wrong claim, broken link, stale number, typo).

## Where

File and section/quote (e.g. `README.md`, "The problem you were asked to solve" — 2nd paragraph).

## What it should say

Your correction, with a source if the claim is factual (link or citation).

## Additional context

Anything else that helps — dates, versions of the underlying work, related repos.
